metadata.description: Curated Claude Code + Codex CLI skills for the Aetheris Solutions agency workflow. Ships /aetheris-review (multi-agent PR review with Aetheris admin ticket integration) and grows as the team standardises shared workflows.

plugins.name: aetheris
plugins.description: Aetheris Solutions agency skills — currently /aetheris-review for multi-agent PR review with ticket integration. Auto-detects the project from the repo URL via the aetheris-admin MCP, injects ticket acceptance criteria into every review agent, tiers findings into blocker / before-merge comments, and posts per-ticket findings back to Aetheris.
